d: BODMER LAB, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The term Bodmer Lab most commonly refers to one of three distinct entities depending on the context': the Geneva digital library and archives (University of Geneva, the Martin Bodmer Foundation, the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny; rare books, manuscripts, 'world literature spanning 3,000 years', the Bodmer Papyri), Rolf Bodmer's cardiovascular laboratory at Sanford Burnham Prebys (Drosophila), and the Bodmer Laboratories of the University of Salford (named after Sir Walter Bodmer). Nine cards across the three.

findings: THE LIBRARY HELD, FIRST. 'A research and digitization project partnering the University of Geneva, the Martin Bodmer Foundation', 'world literature spanning 3,000 years', 'the Bodmer Papyri (early Christian and classical texts)'. The record: 'un partenariat entre la Faculté des lettres de l'Université de Genève et la Fondation Martin Bodmer', 'Une bibliothèque numérique de la littérature mondiale', the Bodmer Papyri constellation. Checked 2026-10-31 against the Revelation First census record of 2026-10-30 and the sources it saved.

A SUPPORTER MADE A PARTNER. 'the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny' is on card 1, the library's own About page, as supporter ('Supported by the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny.'); the partnership the pages state is the faculty's and the Fondation Martin Bodmer's. The composition lists the supporter among the partners.

THE DOMAIN IS THE OTHER LAB'S. The two cards headed 'bodmerlab.org' are Rolf Bodmer's Drosophila laboratory ('The Bodmer Laboratory is investigating in the cellular and molecular basis of heart development'); the Geneva library is at bodmerlab.unige.ch. The bare name resolves by domain to the heart laboratory.

THE PAPYRI THIN. The record's count is '56 documents numérisés' in the papyri constellation and its aim 'a detailed, online catalog of the papyrus and parchment manuscripts at the Fondation Martin Bodmer'; the composition gives the papyri a parenthesis, and their catalogue arrives only on a card ('Online catalog of Greek and Coptic papyrus and parchment manuscripts').
A SPAN WITHOUT A SOURCE. 'world literature spanning 3,000 years' is in no card and no saved page; the Fondation's own pages give the collection's reach in millennia of their own count.
